purpose: Diagnose base learning failure using only the existing 64 training photographs; no augmentation-benefit or generalization claim.
order: First 8 passes from the already fixed stage-validity-pilot order, seed 2026102102.
reason_for_64_steps: Archived base loss diverges appreciably by step11; MPS large losses occur at26-28 and chance-like losses by54. This is a short diagnostic replay, not2048-step retraining.
architecture: Official ImageNet1K V1 pretrained ResNet18 with CPU seed0 Linear(512,2) head.
batch_normalization: Fixed running statistics, trainable affine parameters; restore model train and all BN eval after each probe.
deterministic_note: False for both current arms to isolate backend; archived CPU used True. Compare replay with old CPU trace and disclose any divergence.
same_state_checks: Clone one state and momentum buffers to CPU/MPS, use the same next minibatch for one diagnostic update; do not change the main replay models. Compare logits, full gradients, and SGD updates.
saved_weights: New CPU and MPS step64 model states only (~90MB total); no old results overwritten.
interpretation_limit: The original step2048 states were not saved. A matched short replay can identify the early failure mechanism but cannot directly reconstruct the original final activations. Finite losses/gradients do not imply useful feature learning. Backend differences alone do not prove a backend implementation bug.
